seo.title: Careers & Internships | EireTech360 Ireland
seo.description: Explore early-career and internship pathways with EireTech360 Ireland for curious people ready to learn, contribute and grow.

hero.title: Start your [g]digital chapter.[/g]
hero.subtitle: A welcoming starting point for students, graduates and early-career talent ready to learn through digital work, creative thinking and practical collaboration.

image.alt: A mosaic of early-career professionals from diverse backgrounds

ireland.label: Ireland vision
ireland.title: A warmer start for emerging talent.
ireland.body: We want our Ireland chapter to feel open, encouraging and useful for people taking an early step into digital work.

introduction.label: A practical start
introduction.title: Learn by doing work with purpose.
introduction.body: Bring your questions, interests and ideas. The aim is to build confidence while seeing how strategy, creativity and technology connect.
highlights: Explore the kind of digital work that suits your strengths.
Get practical feedback on your ideas and communication.
Build a clearer picture of where you want to grow next.

opportunities.label: Areas to explore
opportunities.title: Find a direction worth developing.
opportunities.body: Technical, creative or strategic—start a conversation around the work that interests you most.

items.title: Marketing & brand
items.text: Learn how useful messaging and consistent creative work help brands earn attention.

items.title: AI & digital systems
items.text: See how practical tools, websites and automations can make work simpler and more useful.

items.title: Creative collaboration
items.text: Develop the communication habits that help ideas move from first thought to better work.

companion.label: Volunteer with us
companion.title: Would you rather contribute your time and skills?
companion.body: Explore a community-minded way to take part through our volunteer pathway.

cta.label: A simple first step
cta.title: Start with a short hello.
cta.body: Tell us what you are learning, what interests you and what you would like to develop next.
